_comment: Two-tier v2 follow-up L1c (2026-09-17 late, user decision: 'promote the recipe'): the L1 main arms re-trained with the L1b_pa_nodrop_position recipe — plan-token masking rate 0 (the token on every training row) and the two control-smoothness terms off (heading rate 8 -> 0, bank TV 1 -> 0). L1b (plan doc §10.8/§10.10) showed the masking rate is what makes a tracker use its waypoint token (paired truth-plan − no-plan ΔADE p50 −32/−48/−258 m vs −0 without it) and that the smoothness terms cost a third of the fixed-anchor ADE (88 vs 130–134 m); end to end with L2 B_s1337 that arm gave ADE 1268 / fully flyable 0.997 / straight-in established 0.970 (single seed). Three contracts × two seeds so gate L1 and gate E2E can be judged formally. Same cohort as L1.
